set -euo pipefail
ENDPOINT="${1:?usage: $0 <server-public-IP-or-DNS> [port]}"
PORT="${2:-51820}"
SUBNET="10.8.0"
PEERS=(peer1 peer2 peer3)
WG_DIR=/etc/wireguard; CLIENT_DIR="$WG_DIR/clients"

[ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ] || { echo "run as root"; exit 1; }
[ ! -e "$WG_DIR/wg0.conf" ] || { echo "wg0.conf exists; refusing to overwrite"; exit 1; }

umask 077
mkdir -p "$CLIENT_DIR"
SERVER_PRIV="$(wg genkey)"; SERVER_PUB="$(echo "$SERVER_PRIV" | wg pubkey)"

cat > "$WG_DIR/wg0.conf" <<EOF
[Interface]
Address = ${SUBNET}.1/24
ListenPort = ${PORT}
PrivateKey = ${SERVER_PRIV}
PostUp   = iptables -A FORWARD -i %i -j ACCEPT; iptables -A FORWARD -o %i -j ACCEPT; iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -o ${WAN_IF} -j MASQUERADE
PostDown = iptables -D FORWARD -i %i -j ACCEPT; iptables -D FORWARD -o %i -j ACCEPT; iptables -t nat -D POSTROUTING -o ${WAN_IF} -j MASQUERADE
EOF

i=2
for name in "${PEERS[@]}"; do
  PRIV="$(wg genkey)"; PUB="$(echo "$PRIV" | wg pubkey)"; PSK="$(wg genpsk)"
  cat >> "$WG_DIR/wg0.conf" <<EOF

[Peer]
# ${name}
PublicKey = ${PUB}
PresharedKey = ${PSK}
AllowedIPs = ${SUBNET}.${i}/32
EOF

[Interface]
PrivateKey = ${PRIV}
Address = ${SUBNET}.${i}/24
DNS = 1.1.1.1

[Peer]
PublicKey = ${SERVER_PUB}
PresharedKey = ${PSK}
Endpoint = ${ENDPOINT}:${PORT}
AllowedIPs = 0.0.0.0/0, ::/0
PersistentKeepalive = 25
EOF

done
chmod 600 "$WG_DIR"/wg0.conf "$CLIENT_DIR"/*.conf

echo "net.ipv4.ip_forward=1" > /etc/sysctl.d/99-wireguard.conf
sysctl --system >/dev/null

# Idempotent UFW setup: inbound only 22, 80, 443; SSH (22) rate-limited.

# highest number first so numbering stays valid while deleting.

  /^\[ *[0-9]+\]/ {
    line = $0
    sub(/^\[ */, "", line); num = line; sub(/\].*/, "", num)
    sub(/^[0-9]+\] */, "", line)
    split(line, f, /[ \t]+/)
    target = f[1]
    action = (f[2] == "(v6)") ? f[3] : f[2]
    keep = (target == "22/tcp" && action == "LIMIT") || \
           ((target == "80/tcp" || target == "443/tcp") && action == "ALLOW")

  }' | sort -rn)

ufw allow 80/tcp
ufw allow 443/tcp

ufw --force enable
ufw status verbose
